card_name: YES Bank First Business Credit Card
fee_details:
* First Year Fee: Rs.999
* Renewal Fee: Rs.999
* Revolving credit charges: 3.60% per month
* Fuel transaction charges: 1% fee applicable GST for fuel transaction more than Rs.5000 and above
* Education fee payment charges: 1% fee applicable GST on education payments done through third-party websites
joining_perks:
* Welcome Benefits: Get a free voucher worth Rs. 500 on completing transaction worth Rs. 5000 within the first 30 days of getting the credit card.
* Complimentary golf games: Get one complimentary golf game every calendar month or get three free golf games per year at select golf courses across India.
reward_structure:
* Earn 3X reward points on every Rs. 200 spent on air tickets, travel and dining expenses.
* Earn 1X reward points on every Rs. 200 spent on other categories
* Date 20,000 reward points each anniversary year by spending Rs. 80,000 or more. (Denote that the reward points you earned are defined as 12 transactions from the date you converted your reward points to air miles).
* Air mile conversion: convert your reward points to air miles. Do note that reward points are equivalent to Taj Vista Points.
key_highlights:
* Lounge access: Get up to six complimentary international airport lounge access cover on Visa and Mastercard. Get up to eight complimentary domestic lounge access every quarter (approx. 30+ lounge access cross India)
* Insurance Coverage: Coverage of up to Rs 1 Lakh for accidental death of the primary cardholder and liability and facility protection of up to Rs. 8 Lakh.
* Fuel surcharge waiver: You can enjoy a fuel surcharge waiver on transactions ranging from Rs. 5000 to Rs. 5000 across India.
